worker_start: Fetch LATEST.json and remember its Git blob SHA; if its capsule is invalid, fetch PREVIOUS.json.
Fetch the referenced immutable manifest and each part separately.
Materialize them locally and run capsule_runtime_v4.py restore.
If neither pointer restores, materialize exact source from GitHub and continue useful product work.
worker_finish: Write checkpoint inside the workspace before packing.
Run capsule_runtime_v4.py pack; this creates an immutable capsule and local pending pointer.
Upload every part and manifest to a new immutable GitHub capsule directory.
Read every uploaded part back and verify its Git blob SHA/length against local bytes; verify manifest and archive SHA.

Re-read LATEST.json immediately before publication. If its Git blob SHA changed since this run started, another writer won: do not overwrite it; preserve this capsule as an immutable orphan/checkpoint and reconcile on the next run.

If the parent SHA is unchanged, preserve old LATEST as PREVIOUS, then update LATEST using GitHub update_file with that exact parent blob SHA. A stale writer must fail rather than overwrite a newer pointer.
If publication is interrupted before LATEST, the old capsule remains current.
failure_policy: Never repair unknown capsule bytes from conversation memory.
On corrupt LATEST, fall back to PREVIOUS.
On CAS conflict, never force-write LATEST; accept the newer writer and reconcile next run.
If both capsules fail, exact GitHub source is the recovery floor, not a reason to stop product work.
